# Cairn

> Cairn is an open-source personal assistant for people who write code. Start with the free Mac desktop app (`Cairn-<version>-mac-arm64.dmg` or `x64.dmg` in GitHub Releases), which bundles the server, local pi Runner, and owner sign-in. Self-hosting via `npx @xiechimon/cairn` or Docker on Linux and headless servers is the advanced path. Agents run on your own machines using your model subscriptions or API keys. Today there is no hosted service; an official paid hosted service, Cairn Cloud, is planned and not available yet. Self-hosting and the Mac desktop app stay free with full functionality.

- License: Apache-2.0
- Primary install (Mac app first): https://github.com/xiechimon/cairn/releases/latest
- Advanced self-hosted server: `npx @xiechimon/cairn` (Node.js 22 or 24; Linux, macOS, or Docker)
- Source: https://github.com/xiechimon/cairn

The Mac desktop app bundles the web app, Coordinator, SQLite database, and local pi Runner. Extra machines join via `@xiechimon/cairn-cli` Runners. A model source (ChatGPT/Codex subscription, Claude Code subscription, or provider API key) is required. Agents ask before irreversible actions such as deleting data, payments, changing credentials, or publishing. Mail, calendar, and job search are planned, not shipped.

## English documentation

- [Overview](https://cairn.xmon.me/docs/intro/): What Cairn is, its three pieces, and who it is for.
- [Install](https://cairn.xmon.me/docs/install/): Mac desktop app setup first, plus the advanced self-hosted server path.
- [Connect a model](https://cairn.xmon.me/docs/models/): Subscriptions, API keys, and compatible endpoints.
- [Connect a Runner](https://cairn.xmon.me/docs/runner/): Machine enrollment and keeping extra Runners online.
- [Your first task](https://cairn.xmon.me/docs/first-task/): Create a project and follow a task to a result.
- [FAQ](https://cairn.xmon.me/docs/faq/): Cost, privacy, limitations, and troubleshooting.
- [Guides](https://cairn.xmon.me/guides/): Workflow hubs, Q&A, comparisons, and troubleshooting guides.
